id: title:adboio:add sandbox compute rate card pricing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds timezone-awareness checks to sandbox billing configuration, potentially preventing incorrect rate-card calculations when timestamps are naive.
review.reason: Adds a timezone-awareness check before computing sandbox billing, raising an error if timestamps are naive. This could prevent incorrect billing calculations, but the implementation and broader context are not supplied.
review.uncertainty: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied; no implementation, configuration, or migration is provided. The tier is assigned conservatively based on the observed check, but the full implementation and its impact are not established.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are supplied. No other hunks, no implementation of the calling task, no configuration or migration, no runtime behavior. This cannot establish tier or adoption.

observations.behavior: Adds sandbox pricing computation and its tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks timezone-awareness of rate-card timestamps before calculating sandbox billing; failure raises ComputeRateCardConfigurationError.
